data.name: Superconducting ground plane
data.function: Continuous superconducting film covering the die except where qubits, resonators and lines are etched. It provides the return path of every coplanar waveguide; slots in it must be stitched with airbridges or bumps so that spurious slot-line modes do not couple qubits to each other across the chip.

physics.summary: Return conductor for all coplanar structures.

data.tooltip: Ground plane film with etched circuit.
